title: Pakistan
subtitle: Apparel sourcing: costs and risks
meta: Edition of 17 November 2026. Series to {series}, weekly figures of the State Bank to 13 November, scores of 1 November in the appendix.
excerpt: Pakistan reaches the end of 2026 as the mediator of the war in the Gulf and one of its casualties: diesel is a third dearer than a year ago, inflation ran above 10% for six months before easing to 9.6% in October, and the State Bank's rate is back at 12%. The macro repair holds: reserves of USD 31.6 billion including gold, a rupee 1.5% stronger on the year at 276.6, remittances at a record USD 3.9 billion in October, and the IMF's fourth review before the board in December.
